actual_scope: This algorithm gives a sound and complete finite all-height exit decision for fixed rational comparison data, including an explicit tail cutoff and a constructed strict uniform margin. It accepts a two-point law rejected by falling-factorial coefficient domination, handles cancelled leading terms, preserves the p24 calibration and retains the scoped p23 capped-reference obstruction.

stop_rule: Stop after the scoped proof, exact controls and bounded registered replay; do not expand to physical lowering.
